findings.claim: The QA route drives the one-paragraph hands-on instructions beginning at html-css-js/html-and-css/the-box-model/artifact.html:252, but neither the route nor the artifact presents each task as numbered where-to-look, what-to-type-or-press, what-to-expect, and how-to-know-done steps. findings.claim: The lesson and recap state that adjacent vertical block margins in normal flow collapse to the larger margin. That is only the positive-margin result after the margins are actually adjoining; borders, padding, clearance, line boxes, height/min-height and formatting-context boundaries can prevent adjoining, and negative margins use a different calculation.

evidence.section: 8.3.1 Collapsing margins: adjoining conditions and calculation with positive and negative margins

findings.recommendation: Scope the rule to the demonstrated case: two adjoining positive vertical margins between sibling blocks, with no separating border, padding, clearance, or new formatting context. Briefly note that negative margins and parent/child collapse follow additional rules outside this beginner example.
